summary:
Strategy reset after independent surveys. Both reviewers found that plain RL has plateaued against relay and balanced: about 15-20% wins, with goal difference improving only ~0.3 per 100M samples. The gap is behaviour, not action expressivity: relay rounded to our action bins, with sonar disabled, still beats us ~70%. We hit walls 1-1.7 times per player per match; relay's whole team averages ~0.04.

Now running:
  • k1 (kickstarting): PPO plus an imitation loss toward a shadow relay teacher's actions on our own states (DAgger-style), fading over 150M samples. So far wall deaths are down to 0.83 per player; goals dipped mid-transition.
  • m5b: the unchanged control.
  • Plan B in development: the network picks heading and speed, and a fixed physics controller drives the sphere (the probe found cloning works much better there).
Methodology fixes: one or two focused jobs instead of four (throughput per job back up); paired A/B tool (128 games per opponent with CIs); re-pickup delay tracked. The league's frozen opponents now play greedy, like the deployed model. Repo: front page index.html + model gallery/viewer.

updates.text: Exact simulator (bit-identical to engine), feature encoder, PPO trainer done; M2 training started on the training machine.
Phase 1 reviewed (2 critical reward bugs fixed). Exporter (M1) done: bit-exact, ~1 ms callbacks. Evaluation harness done. League + mirror self-play added. m2b training.
M2 learning: 3.2 goals/match vs idle at 38M samples. Review round 2 fixes in. Replay viewer added. Idle-bonus shaping artifact found and fixed.
M2 gate passed (8 goals/match vs idle). 7 strong scripted training opponents added. Review round 3 done. M3 (m3b) running. Merged another session's push to main without loss.
Replay analysis: our players far slower than scripted bots. Added a clear-ground memory map and ray inputs (features v2) with warm-start surgery; m3c running. GRU option built.
Features v2 (clear-ground rays) lifted baseline win rate 44%→78%. Review fixes (exact ray traversal etc.). Learner moved to GPU + pipelining: ~290M samples/h. m3d running.
m3d u300: baseline 94%, camper 22%, guardian/rusher 16%, relay 6%, balanced 3%. Replay vs relay: 7-14 (was 2-19).
Rollouts 1.43x faster (bit-identical, fixture-tested). Adaptive opponent mix on (shifts training toward relay/balanced etc.). m3d u450: baseline 97%, camper 25%, relay 9%, balanced 6%.
Plateau vs relay/balanced. Greedy decoding >> sampling. lr 1e-3 A/B worse. Capacity A/B (Net2Wider 256x256) running. Defence potential implemented.
Features v4 + fine throttle bins + defence potential + focused league curriculum. A/B on entropy/λ running (m4a/m4b).
m4b (low entropy, λ 0.99) wins the A/B. Release pipeline built; first candidate passes all checks. Feature registry + v5 memory features in progress.
m4c (lower entropy, higher λ) slightly beats m4b: guardian/rusher/camper ~50% held-out. v5 features + strict migration done (reviewed). A/B v5 vs v4 running. Releasing m4c as teams/exml_rl.
Released teams/exml_rl (m4c u210): 54% overall vs 10 bots; baseline 92%; latency p99 0.29 ms on a quiet machine.
v5 adopted (m5a). Replay vs relay: won 8-5 (was 2-19). Support-potential A/B (m5b) started to fix slow re-pickup (195 vs 51 ticks).

Surveys done: plateau confirmed; both rank kickstarting from relay #1. k1 kickstarting run vs m5b control running. Repo cleaned, single main branch, front page + gallery. Plan B (heading/speed + controller) being built.

Kickstarting in the bins action space failed (k1, k2). Paired A/B: m5b ≈ release (no progress in 10 h; worse vs guardian). Switched to the generalist league g1 from the release lineage; plan B (heading/speed action space) in development.
